headline: Indian IT services showed mixed performance in Q2 FY27, with top firms posting solid growth while others stalled.
summary: TCS delivered 11.2% YoY revenue growth and modest profit expansion. HCLTech saw a 21% YoY profit jump and raised its FY27 revenue guidance. Wipro recorded flat revenue YoY and only a 1.5% QoQ increase. Overall, AI revenue contributions are rising, but margin pressure remains for some peers.

themes.title: AI as a growth driver
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI revenue exceeding 10% of total revenue and rapid YoY growth, signalling a strategic focus.

themes.title: Margin stability
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed in the mid‑teens for most firms, with HCLTech maintaining a 31.6% EBIT margin outlook.

leaders.why: Revenue up 11.2% YoY and profit grew QoQ; AI revenue now >10% of total.
Profit jumped 21% YoY, revenue grew 11.5% YoY and guidance was raised.

laggards.why: Revenue flat YoY and only modest QoQ growth; operating margin unchanged.
